column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Won't Listen To Her Best Friend - G
Hey, Kirino. About that... It all started when I consulted Onii-san about what to get you for having participated in the track-and-field tournament.
With this guy? Why?
Eh... T-That's...
If it's Onii-san, I'm sure he knows what Kirino likes... and what Kirino truly desires the most... That's what I thought.
...H-Hmmm.
Hey Kirino, don't say too much. You'll expose yourself.
...I get it. However, you'll have to explain things to me afterwards. Why would Ayase...
Hmm, where was I?
Right right, I got Onii-san to help me search for the "thing Kirino truly desires the most right now".
That's right, and that was the championship prize "EX Meruru limited-edition figurine" for the cosplay tournament.
Isn't this practically nude, diiiiiiiiiie--!!
I will absolutely not wear such lewd clothing!
It was really a horrifying time for me back then...
After listening to my advice, Ayase decided to partake in the cosplay competition to win that EX Meruru limited-edition figurine. However, she didn't
personally join in the competition...
She requested a classmate called Kanako that looked exactly like Meruru to join in her place.
In the end, she successfully claimed the championship...
...And so, she was able to get the grand prize figurine.
And that's how it was.
However, there's something important Ayase didn't mention.
Ayase, talk about that too. About how Kirino was among the audience in the cosplay competition.
Eh...that...too?
It's all right. Kirino doesn't mind about you having seen her back then. Right, Kirino?
...? Y-Yeah, I guess...
Although I feel there's a problem with that too...
Uhh, Kirino at that time was...
Yahoo! Ku-ra-ra! Ku-ra-ra! Yeah yeah yeah yeah!
Don't say such stupid things!
Guwah!
W-Why did you kick me?!
I just felt like it for some reason!
...Hey, Kirino.
If you hit others based on feelings, I don't think humanity has a future any more.
I actually wore a pink hanten coat and danced together with gross otaku while waving around a lightstick and a fan!?
That's the most unbelievable of all the things I've been told up till now!
Hey, Ayase! These are all lies, right!? Tell me that they're lies!
Well, that's... I didn't believe it myself either... However, when I actually saw it...
Guh... H-How could this be...
